title: Australian Citizenship Test: Why the Values Questions Matter
excerpt: You must answer all five values questions correctly, even with a 75% score.
description: In the Australian citizenship test you must answer all five values questions correctly as well as scoring 75%. Here's what that means and how to prepare.
body:
In the Australian citizenship test, scoring 75% isn't enough on its own. You must also answer all five Australian values questions correctly.

## The format

- 20 multiple-choice questions
- 45 minutes
- You need 75% overall
- And every one of the 5 values questions must be correct

## What the values questions cover

They're based on the values section of the official resource, Australian Citizenship: Our Common Bond. They cover ideas like freedom, equality, respect and the rule of law.

## How to prepare

- Read the values chapter until you know it well
- Practise values questions separately, not just as part of mock tests
- Learn the three levels of government and what each one does
- Take full mock tests until you pass with room to spare

Check the Home Affairs website for the current rules. Try a free mock test below.
